note: jit-batch: the one game gate per compiler batch, run once before a release (docs/537 §17, docs/TESTING.md). A batch's per-method proof is in the host: coverage bar (tools/jit-coverage.ts), differential corpus, bench (tools/jit-bench.ts). No per-method game runs. Before a run point every job's asi at the batch build and raise minCounters to that build. Correctness only, no timing. Full mode set under Mode=2: Direct=1 DirectLeaf=0 (chains, guarded callvirt), Inline=2, Wide=1. Pass per job as in jit-verify.json: no crash, 0 watchdog lines, ScriptError count as the job's baseline, jitOn 2, jitMethods >= the compilable count of the list, jitVerified > 100000, jitMismatch 0, jitFaults 0, plus jitLazyCalls >= 1000 (nativeRequire), jitLazyMats > 0, jitInlined > 0, jitWide > 0. Any 'jit verify MISMATCH' line fails the job (logForbid): triage first, and add the method's failing input to the host corpus. Methods with clauses are not verified per call. Run: node tools/harness/queue.ts tools/harness/queues/jit-batch.json --no-smoke
